policy.default_collection: 62 resident-unclaimed task IDs after three semantic-oracle pauses (32common/30specialist); actual current-version Linux CPU applicability remains mandatory. No collection/GPU starts from this metadata.
policy.exploration: All remaining resident-unclaimed tasks are retained; role quotas follow that remaining pool, mechanism/repository round-robin within each role
policy.same_reward: Lower revisit priority for this observed state; not a permanent task exclusion
policy.null_reward: Pause scoring-unknown tasks pending cause review; never convert null to model failure
policy.preserved: Same original100 task IDs, roles, mechanisms, source snapshots, families and reference oracle; 38 task/problem versions explicitly revised, original version and rewards preserved
policy.familiarity: Resident-unclaimed means unclaimed in cancelled R1/R2/R3 only; older v4/16K sampling and prepared demonstrations exist
policy.limitation: Historical signals rank collection effort; this is not heldout evaluation, current-policy reward relabeling or proof of learning benefit
policy.weak_oracle: Pause original-oracle RL for qrcode SVG84,OSA85,iniconfig95 on actual task-contract counterexamples. Correct off-policy SFT and all100 identities/oracles/historical rewards remain unchanged. No blanket reliability claim for other97.

problem_version_scope: 38 explicit revised task/prompt identities; historical claims/outcomes remain bound to previous problem versions and are scheduling evidence only. CPU usability is checked separately against current task/snapshot/isolation.
